elements.name: Keep the application controls reachable at the minimum window size

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the MCAD Software is open in a restored window with an active part
the user drags the bottom right corner inward past the supported minimum size
the window stops shrinking at its minimum size
Minimize, Maximize and Close remain fully visible and usable
the active part remains displayed in the resized viewport
docked side panels scale proportionally without hiding the active document tab or overflowing the ribbon
any open floating feature panel remains clamped inside the visible viewport bounds
